title: anubis-solver CPU/GPU Benchmark Results
subtitle: Performance benchmarks of the anubis-solver across all challenge tiers (fast, slow, sha256, hashx, argon2id) with thread scaling, AVX comparison, and GPU backend analysis
description:
This dataset contains comprehensive benchmark results for the anubis-solver proof-of-work engine. It includes:

1. **CPU Benchmarks**: All challenge tiers (fast, slow, sha256, hashx, argon2id) at light/medium/hard difficulties
2. **Thread Scaling**: Performance scaling from 1 to 16 threads
3. **AVX Comparison**: Native dispatch (AVX-512) vs forced AVX2 performance
4. **GPU Backend Comparison**: CUDA, Level Zero, Vulkan, OpenCL, CPU fallback (when run on GPU-enabled systems)

The solver implements proof-of-work for TecharoHQ/anubis challenges including:
- fast/slow (nibble-based, 16^d difficulty)
- sha256 (bit-based, 2^d difficulty)  
- hashx (bit-based, dynamic WASM kernel)
- argon2id (memory-hard, parameterized)

All digests are verified against hashlib to ensure correctness.
